mapper.select: select d.dept_id as DEPT_ID, d.parent_dept_id as PARENT_DEPT_ID, d.leader_id as LEADER_ID, d.dept_name as DEPT_NAME, d.is_active as IS_ACTIVE, d.is_deleted as IS_DELETED, d.version as VERSION, d.created_at as CREATED_AT, d.created_by as CREATED_BY, d.updated_at as UPDATED_AT, d.updated_by as UPDATED_BY from departments_51 d where d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.is_deleted = 'n'

select d.dept_id as DEPT_ID, d.parent_dept_id as PARENT_DEPT_ID, d.leader_id as LEADER_ID, d.dept_name as DEPT_NAME, d.is_active as IS_ACTIVE, d.is_deleted as IS_DELETED, d.version as VERSION, d.created_at as CREATED_AT, d.created_by as CREATED_BY, d.updated_at as UPDATED_AT, d.updated_by as UPDATED_BY from departments_51 d where d.is_deleted = 'n' order by d.dept_id asc

select d.dept_id as DEPT_ID, d.parent_dept_id as PARENT_DEPT_ID, d.leader_id as LEADER_ID, d.dept_name as DEPT_NAME, d.is_active as IS_ACTIVE, d.is_deleted as IS_DELETED, d.version as VERSION, d.created_at as CREATED_AT, d.created_by as CREATED_BY, d.updated_at as UPDATED_AT, d.updated_by as UPDATED_BY from departments_51 d
d.is_deleted = 'n'
and ( d.dept_name like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
or d.dept_id = CAST(#{searchKeyword} AS BIGINT)
)
and d.is_active = #{searchStatus}
order by d.dept_id asc

select d.dept_id as DEPT_ID, d.parent_dept_id as PARENT_DEPT_ID, d.leader_id as LEADER_ID, d.dept_name as DEPT_NAME, d.is_active as IS_ACTIVE, d.is_deleted as IS_DELETED, d.version as VERSION, d.created_at as CREATED_AT, d.created_by as CREATED_BY, d.updated_at as UPDATED_AT, d.updated_by as UPDATED_BY from departments_51 d where d.parent_dept_id is null and d.is_deleted = 'n' order by d.dept_id asc

select d.dept_id as DEPT_ID, d.parent_dept_id as PARENT_DEPT_ID, d.leader_id as LEADER_ID, d.dept_name as DEPT_NAME, d.is_active as IS_ACTIVE, d.is_deleted as IS_DELETED, d.version as VERSION, d.created_at as CREATED_AT, d.created_by as CREATED_BY, d.updated_at as UPDATED_AT, d.updated_by as UPDATED_BY from departments_51 d where d.parent_dept_id = #{parentDeptId} and d.is_deleted = 'n' order by d.dept_id asc
select p.dept_name as PARENT_DEPT_NAME from departments_51 d inner join departments_51 p on d.parent_dept_id = p.dept_id where d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.is_deleted = 'n' and p.is_deleted = 'n'
select e.name as LEADER_NAME from departments_51 d inner join employees_51 e on d.leader_id = e.emp_id where d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.is_deleted = 'n' and e.is_deleted = 'n'
select count(*) as CNT from employees_51 e where e.dept_id = #{deptId} and e.is_deleted = 'n'
select count(*) as CNT from departments_51 d where d.leader_id = #{empId} and d.is_deleted = 'n'
mapper.insert: insert into departments_51 ( parent_dept_id, leader_id, dept_name, is_active, is_deleted, version, created_at, created_by ) values ( #{parentDeptId}, #{leaderId}, #{deptName}, #{isActive}, #{isDeleted}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: update departments_51 set parent_dept_id = #{parentDeptId}, leader_id = #{leaderId}, dept_name = #{deptName}, is_active = #{isActive}, version = #{version} + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} where dept_id = #{deptId} and version = #{version} and is_deleted = 'n'
mapper.select: select count(*) as CNT from departments_51 d where d.is_deleted = 'n' and d.is_active = 'y'
select distinct d.leader_id from departments_51 d where d.leader_id is not null and d.is_deleted = 'n'

select d.dept_id as deptId, d.parent_dept_id as parentDeptId, d.leader_id as leaderId, d.dept_name as deptName, p.dept_name as parentDeptName, e.name as leaderName, (select count(*) from employees_51 e2 where e2.dept_id = d.dept_id and e2.is_deleted = 'n') as employeeCount, d.is_active as isActive, d.is_deleted as isDeleted, d.version as version, d.created_at as createdAt, d.created_by as createdBy from departments_51 d left join departments_51 p on d.parent_dept_id = p.dept_id and p.is_deleted = 'n' left join employees_51 e on d.leader_id = e.emp_id and e.is_deleted = 'n' where d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.is_deleted = 'n'
select dept_id as deptId, dept_name as deptName from departments_51 where is_deleted = 'n' order by dept_name asc
select distinct d.leader_id from departments_51 d where d.parent_dept_id = #{parentDeptId} and d.leader_id is not null and d.is_deleted = 'n'
